tutorial.say: A clue shaped like this next to a row (or above a column) counts the GROUPS of bombs in the line: bombs that touch side by side are one group, and a gap starts a new one.
This row has three bombs, but only 2 groups: the pair on the left counts as one, and the lonely bomb is another.
The number of bombs is not given, only how they are grouped. A 1 means all the bombs of the line sit together; a 0 means there are none.

tutorial.play: Your turn! The board is cleared again. Find all the bombs.
